title: sorbus domestica var. pyrifera
intro: Sorbus domestica var. pyrifera, commonly known as the Chinese Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, making it a potential remedy for various health issues such as digestive problems, fever, and respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Sorbus domestica var. pyrifera include treating coughs, sore throats, and other respiratory issues, as well as acting as a natural antiseptic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties and health benefits.
